about: Golden set for MeetingAgent (ADR-0038 D7): agenda status updates, off-agenda drift and raised carried items, with false-positive cases (asides, passing mentions, host-set items, never-record). Run through the real MeetingAgent.process_meeting; the model answer is replayed. expected.updates lists the updates that must REACH the host (after the agent's own rules), expected.off_agenda whether an off_agenda nudge is emitted, expected.raised the carried items (1-based) marked raised.
default_carried: Priya to send the vendor shortlist

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay, that's the roadmap settled then, the three themes stay as they are.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Good. Moving on to hiring, um, we have two open reqs and one offer out.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Right, so for the backend req the pipeline is pretty thin.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Let's do the pricing page now, uh, design is basically done.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: -- copy too?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Copy's in review. The open thing is the comparison table, whether we show the enterprise column.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Totally separate thing, but the office move, are we doing the fourth floor or not?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Facilities said the fourth floor is ready in January, but parking is a mess.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: And the lease on the old space runs to March, so we'd pay double for two months.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay so we need a number on that.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Anyone want coffee? I'm grabbing one.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I'm good, thanks.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay, back to the roadmap, theme two is the reporting work.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: On the roadmap, reporting slips a sprint, we'll get to hiring later, it's related.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Fine, so reporting lands in the second December sprint.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Pria, the vendor shortlist from last time, where is it?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: It's three vendors, I'll share it today. Two of them can do the SSO piece, um, the third can't.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay, then the third is out.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Remind me about the offsite venue at the end. For now, roadmap theme three.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Theme three is the mobile parity work, still scoped at six weeks.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Still on the roadmap, the reporting theme needs one more engineer.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: We could borrow someone from platform for a sprint.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: Platform is stretched, um, but maybe.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: We're out of time for incidents. Let's push incident follow-ups to next week.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Fine, defer it, nothing urgent there.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Hiring, quickly, the offer to the designer went out yesterday.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Great, and the backend req is still open.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sorry to derail, but Northwind escalated again this morning, their exports are failing.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Is it the timeout thing? Support said it's every export over ten thousand rows.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: Yeah, and they're threatening to pause the renewal.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: How was everyone's weekend? I finally got the garden done.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Ha, nice. Mine was mostly rain.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Pricing page is done, it goes live Monday, nothing left to discuss there.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Great, next item then.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Between us, the layoffs list for January is at fourteen names.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Okay, we keep that off the record.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: -- the conference booth, did we ever book the bigger one?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: We have the small one, the big one was eight thousand more.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: -- for three days?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Three days, plus the swag budget on top.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: For roadmap theme one, the pricing engine refactor is the long pole.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Right, that's the internal engine, not the page, and it's eight weeks.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay, incident follow-ups. Two open items from the outage on the third.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: The runbook update is done, the alerting change isn't.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sorry, my dog is barking, one second.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No worries.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay, I'm back. Where were we on theme two?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Great, so the hiring plan is agreed, the two reqs are approved, done.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Done. Next.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: The offsite venue from last time. Lisbon or the lake place?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Lisbon is cheaper with flights, the lake place needs a bus.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Then Lisbon, unless finance objects.
